notes: Eleven distinct movable-part episodes are reported. The paired leaves of each two-door upper cabinet are treated separately, as required, although their individual motions occur within short sampling intervals and therefore have lower timing confidence.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a compact kitchen in which the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets are opened and closed, followed by lid or drawer interactions with two countertop cookers and an air fryer.
